answer: Pin paid keys to places, Helium-style. Each earning key pairs a cheap LoRa radio (assumed $40) that, at beacon-picked minutes, chirps a signed nonce; three beacon-drawn strangers' radios must hear it, and signal timing fixes it to a 300 m hex where only 2 keys earn. 500 radios in one garden shed share a hex; a radio alone by a lagoon gets no witnesses and earns nothing. A 500-key farm needs 250 witnessed sites, at an assumed $10/month each, ~$2,500/month. Copying a sonnet is free; copying a rooftop isn't.
